name: Rumbleback Mole
summary: A blind mole the size of a house that tunnels through solid rock and brings the ceiling down on anything in its way.
description: Rumblebacks carve the great round tunnels that other creatures later call roads. They are not hunters by nature, but they are territorial, and they answer any loud noise by digging toward it. Whole mining camps have moved after feeling the floor begin to shudder in a slow, steady rhythm.

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.text: The mole can burrow through solid rock at half its {ref:glossary/burrow-speed} and leaves a 15-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The mole makes two Digging Claw attacks.

actions.name: Cave-In

save.targets: each other creature within 30 feet of the mole

actions.onFailure: and the target has the {ref:condition/prone} condition.
actions.onFailureOrSuccess: The ground within 30 feet of the mole becomes {ref:glossary/difficult-terrain} until cleared.
